Before you sign up, here\'s what {appName} keeps about you, and why. The full privacy policy has the details.

Your phone number or Google account, what you put in your profile (name, birth date, gender, photos, answers), who you\'d like to meet, your approximate area, and what you do in the app, like likes, matches and messages.
Only an approximate area of a few kilometres is kept. Others see your city and a rounded distance, never where you are.
Photos are checked before anyone sees them, and the hidden data in them, like where they were taken, is removed.
Your first name, age, photos and what you choose to share. Never your phone number, your birth date or your exact location.
As long as you have an account. If you delete it, your profile disappears at once and the rest is erased within 30 days, apart from what the law requires us to keep.
You can change or delete what you\'ve shared, download a copy of your data, and delete your account at any time, in the app or on our website.
{appName} is for adults: you need to be 18 or older to use it.
By continuing you accept the terms of use (version %1$d) and the privacy policy (version %2$d).
While this lasts, others can\'t see you and you can\'t use {appName}. Here\'s why, and how to appeal.
Tell us what happened. A person on our team will read it.
Your appeal has been sent. We\'ll reply here in the app.
Your appeal was reviewed and the decision stands.
You can still change your mind and bring it back.
It will be deleted for good on %1$s. Until then you can bring it back.
Restoring brings back your profile, matches and messages as they were.
We look at new profiles before they\'re shown, to keep {appName} real. This usually doesn\'t take long.
We\'ll let you know when you\'re in. If something needs changing, we\'ll tell you what and why.
{appName} is down for a short maintenance. Try again in a few minutes.
